rule_yaml:
title: Windows Event Log Service Disabled via Registry
id: 224751aa-0dae-58dd-b3a9-31c30ee095cc
status: experimental
description: Detects modification of the Windows EventLog service Start registry value
  to 0x4 (disabled), which impairs defense capabilities by preventing event logging.
  This is commonly used by attackers to hide their activities.
author: Sentinel Loop rule_gen v0
date: '2026-10-02'
tags:
- attack.t1685.001
- attack.t1562.002
logsource:
  category: registry_set
  product: windows
detection:
  selection1:
    TargetObject|endswith:
    - HKLM\System\CurrentControlSet\Services\EventLog\Start
    Details|contains:
    - DWORD (0x00000004)
  filter1:
    Image|endswith:
    - services.exe
    - svchost.exe
    - mmc.exe
    - regedit.exe
  condition: 1 of selection* and not 1 of filter*
falsepositives:
- Legitimate administrative action to disable EventLog service (rare)
- System maintenance scripts that temporarily disable EventLog
level: high

title: MSBuild Execution with Project File from Suspicious Directory
id: 6c81e1a5-63ae-56c2-870c-6bbf5a4a073f
status: experimental
description: Detects MSBuild.exe executing an XML project file from suspicious directories
  commonly abused for code execution, such as Windows Tasks folders, Temp directories,
  or user profile locations.
author: Sentinel Loop rule_gen v0
date: '2026-10-02'
tags:
- attack.t1127.001
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection1:
    Image|endswith:
    - MSBuild.exe
    CommandLine|contains:
    - .xml
    - Windows/Tasks/
    - Windows/System32/Tasks/
    - Windows/SysWow64/Tasks/
    - Users/Public/
    - AppData/Local/Temp/
    - AppData/Local/Roaming/
    - Windows/Temp/
  condition: 1 of selection*
falsepositives:
- Legitimate build processes referencing project files in unusual locations (rare)
level: high
